title: Concerning the Ambassador.

47. Concerning the Ambassador. 47.
Once again, hear this other word that I shall teach you about it
in truth: that beforehand, before night and day
were separated forth in the cosmos, they called forth the Third
{7}Ambassador. Then afterwards they sent him to this watch
and this watcher who is outside, that he might purify the light
and separate night and day from one another.
{8}efore they raised the light, and it went forth, and came up
in the Zone, the Father of Life adorned for him the ships
of the light. He established them, so that he might purify in them
and depict it, and fashion it in an ordering.
{9}orehand, before Sin became great and reigned in the flesh, before
they should distinguish the radiant ones with the destroyed{10} from one another,
{11}they sent forth the Judge. He was manifested forth, they fashioned
his throne, they placed him {12} the living air, that he might become
{13}righteous Judge, in order that they might cast forth from
{14}him, and that they might examine the righteous with the sinners
{15}and divide them from one another. Beforehand also, before
{16} Error and the scandal of the doctrines were manifested
{17}forth in the cosmos, they appointed and brought forth, against them, the Chri-
{18}st, the blessed, that he might cut down their Error.
{19} also, {20} they begot men, and named some
{21} some others 'poor' on the earth
{22} ... they cast(?) before they killed
⟨p.118⟩
Of those whom they shall slay, they appointed the stars and the {1}
and the spheres that are fitted to them, that they may be born from them{2},
and that they bind their root in their days, and that they keep
watch over them within them, and turn them in a judgment of recompense
according to their works and their sins.
Once again, beforehand — before the cosmos is released forth {3} earth
entire — they appointed and gave a sign to the releasers, that they should release {4} —
release forth. Once again, beforehand — before they {5}
ad{6}orn and appoint the Aeon, the {7} summoned
{8}great Builder, the First Architect, with the
angels who are with him, who shall build and adorn the Aeon
of the new.
